  "on_screen_text": "Keeper: Storm's coming. What brings you up here? / I brought you some tea. / Just looking around. — Wikipedia-style Bandersnatch info box: approached by Netflix about making an interactive film in May 2017... Netflix's creation of a bespoke program called Branch Manager... Bandersnatch was originally to be part of Black Mirror's 5th series... Cinematography: Will Poulter, Aaron Mordor; Music by: Tony Kearns; Production companies: Brian Reitzell / House of Tomorrow; Distributed by: Netflix; Release date: 28 December 2018; Running time: Default 90 minutes, Total 312 minutes; Country: United Kingdom; Language: English; Critics praised the technical design of the film but criticised the story's characterisation... — TWINE (title card) — itch.io: Browse Games, Game Jams, Login, Register; Top / Games / Jams; Sort by Popular, New & Popular, Top sellers, Most Recent; made with Twine (23,756 results); Select a tab...; Filter; Romance, Fantasy, Meaningful Choices, Mystery, Role Playing, Narrative (View all tags); itch.io on YouTube — Subscribe for game recommendations, clips, and more; View Channel — Archiving and Exporting Stories: Archiving Your Library — Archiving your library saves all stories in it to a single file. You can use an archive as a way to back up your work, or to move your library between computers or different web browsers. To create an archive, choose the Archive button under the Library top toolbar tab... Exporting a Story — To export a single story, select it and choose Publish to File from the Build top toolbar tab... — Subtitle overlays: Ever wondered how a game lets you choose what to say, / 게임은 어떻게 내가 할 말을 고르게 하고 — Even Netflix's Bandersnatch was written in it. / 넷플릭스 「밴더스내치」도 이걸로 썼습니다. — You write a story as linked passages, / 이야기를 서로 이어진 단락으로 쓰면 — so you can upload it to itch.io, and that is your game. / itch.io에 올리면 그게 바로 게임입니다. — To use it inside a game engine, choose Export as Twee to get plain text. / 게임 엔진 안에서 쓰려면 Export as Twee로 평범한 글을 받습니다. — Keeper / Then look quickly. (lighthouse illustration); passage: Look   $trust = 0 — Twine editor: Back / Passage / Story / Build / Twine; Start passage box: (set: $trust to 0) Keeper: Storm's coming. What brings you up here? [[Brought you tea->Tea]] [[Just looking around->Look]] — Twine story map view: linked passage nodes including Start, Tea, Look, Lamp with connecting arrows — Keeper: That's kind. Sit by the fire. / Watch the lamp — Twee export code: :: StoryTitle / The Lighthouse / :: StoryData { \"ifid\": \"...\", \"format\": \"Harlowe\", \"format-version\": \"3.3.9\", \"start\": \"Start\" } :: Start Keeper: Storm's coming. What brings you up here? [[Brought you tea->Tea]] [[Just looking around->Look]] :: Lamp [lamp] Keeper: Time to light the lamp. (if: $trust >= 1)[Keeper: Here's a secret: the old map is under the third step.](else:)[Keeper: Goodnight, stranger.] :: Look Keeper: Then look quickly. [[Watch the lamp->Lamp]] :: Start",
  "key_claims": [
    "Twine has let creators write choice-based, state-remembering games since 2009",
    "Netflix's Bandersnatch was written using Twine",
    "A Twine story is written as linked passages, with each passage shown as a box on a map",
    "Double square brackets create links, which become both player choices and arrows on the story map",
    "Variables can store and remember player choices (e.g., bringing tea adds 1 to a trust variable)",
    "An if-check can gate content (e.g., a secret) based on a variable like trust",
    "Publish to File exports a single HTML file playable in any browser, which can be uploaded to itch.io",
    "Export as Twee produces plain text that can be read by a game engine with a suitable parser",
    "The reel's story was run in Twine 2.12.1 and Godot 4.3",
    "A custom Godot parser was written specifically for this episode and only supports the passages, links, and Harlowe macros used in this story — it is not an official integration or a general-purpose Harlowe runtime",
    "In the Godot example, a script reads passages, turns links into choices, and lights a lamp when a passage is tagged 'lamp'",
    "Twine is open-source under the GPL-3.0 license",
    "Harlowe 3.3.9 (by Leon Arnott) is licensed Zlib; the Godot integration code is MIT licensed"
  ],
  "info_channel": "caption"
}
